comment: The pinned playpex-torrentd release (engines/torrentd, built on anacrolix/torrent): per platform, the URL of the binary published on the Playpex GitHub releases and its SHA-256 (written by `node engines/torrentd/build.js --pin` after the release workflow published tag torrentd-v<version>). Empty until the first release: until then `npm run build:torrentd` builds it from source into <cache>/engines/torrentd (Go 1.26+).
